tasks.prompt:
Weekly status update reminder fired. Follow the cron-renewal protocol from memory FIRST:

1. Run CronList to check if this weekly status job still exists and when it was created
2. If the job is at risk of expiring (created >5 days ago), add a ⚠️ renewal notice
3. If the job already expired, add a 🔴 expired notice
4. Then ask the user for their work items this week (completed, in progress, risks/blockers, next week focus)
5. Generate the weekly status update draft following the template in memory (150-250 English words, bullet points, professional tone)

If user replies "renew" / "续期" / "yes" to a renewal notice, recreate the cron job with: cron "3 17 * * 5", durable true, recurring true, same prompt. Update the cron-renewal-protocol memory with the new job ID.
